sensitivity_range: Sensitivity must be between 0 and 1 (0.5 = calibrated)
track_side_invalid: Side “{side}”: a single letter is expected (A, B …)
event_master_mismatch: Master comparison #{id} finished: does not match the master
recording_interrupted: The service stopped during the recording
no_capture_device: No capture device found. Is the turntable connected via USB and switched on?
discogs_info_ui: {user} (personal access token, saved in the settings)
discogs_info_config: {user} (personal access token from the configuration file)
discogs_off_desktop: Discogs is not set up: enter a personal access token under Settings → Discogs
discogs_off_service: Discogs is not set up: enter a personal access token under Settings → Discogs, or set discogs_token and discogs_username in the configuration file
discogs_no_image: Discogs has no image for this release
master_no_space: Not enough space for the master ({gb:.1f} GB)
master_unreadable: Not a readable audio file (WAV, FLAC or AIFF)
master_format: Format {format} is not supported (WAV, FLAC or AIFF)
master_too_short: Only {s:.0f} s long: one record side as one file is expected
no_master_upload: No master for side {side}: upload it on the record page
audio_deleted: The original audio of the recording has been deleted
analyze_first: The recording must be analyzed first
approval_no_copies: No copy of this side has been measured against the master yet.

approval_stamper_spots_all.one: {n} audible spot identical on several copies, {on_all} of them on all {copies}: {times}.
approval_stamper_spots_all.other: {n} audible spots identical on several copies, {on_all} of them on all {copies}: {times}.

approval_stamper_spots.one: {n} audible spot identical on several copies: {times}.
approval_stamper_spots.other: {n} audible spots identical on several copies: {times}.

approval_stamper_rework: More than {max} on all copies: have the stamper or the cut reworked; this affects the whole run.
approval_stamper_report: This is in the stamper or the cut: report it to the pressing plant so it can be checked. No reason against approval.
approval_stamper_none: No audible defects at the same spot on several copies.
approval_stamper_detail: {common} quiet and loud spots identical on several copies, {on_all} on all (expected by chance: {expected}).
approval_cut_speed: {pct:+.3f} % against the master (median, turntable factored out where calibrated); limit ±{limit:.1f} %.

approval_vs_master_outliers.one: Median {grade} over {n} copy; outliers: {outliers} (single copies, not the run).
approval_vs_master_outliers.other: Median {grade} over {n} copies; outliers: {outliers} (single copies, not the run).

approval_pre_echo: strongest {db:.0f} dB relative to the music (audible in quiet entries from about {limit:.0f} dB).
approval_hf_end: {db:+.1f} dB at 10 kHz compared with the start (inner-groove loss, includes the cartridge).
approval_polarity_inverted: Polarity inverted relative to the master, the same on all copies: chain or cut, not audible.
not_analyzed_yet: The recording has not been analyzed yet
report_noise: {noise} dBFS · A-weighted {noise_a} dBFS · {rel} dB relative to the music
no_master_for_record: No master is stored for this record
no_master_map: No master comparison with a time mapping (or the master was removed)
no_release_id: The record has no Discogs release ID: take it from the collection first
recording_not_of_record: The recording does not belong to this record
recording_no_grade: The recording has no grade (analysis missing, or a calibration)
copy_no_grade: This copy has no record grade yet (no graded side)
alignment_needs_setup: For an alignment recording, please create an alignment run first
record_required: Please select a record for this recording first
recorder_busy: A recording or level check is already running
profile_not_connected: “{name}” is not connected (device {device} missing). Connect the turntable via USB and switch it on, or choose another profile.
event_side_end: The side is probably ending: keep an eye on the stylus; the recording stops by itself in the run-out groove.
event_end_groove: Run-out groove detected, recording stopped. The analysis is running.
nothing_running: No recording or level check is running
rewind_recording_only: Rewinding only works during a recording, not during the level check

audio_retention_deleted.one: Original audio deleted after {n} day of retention. Measurements, clicks and comparisons are kept.
audio_retention_deleted.other: Original audio deleted after {n} days of retention. Measurements, clicks and comparisons are kept.

findings_need_record: Findings belong to a record; this recording has none
label_invalid: label must be one of: {allowed} (or null)
recording_not_analyzed: Recording not found or not analyzed
no_event_at_time: No event at this time (±3 ms)
no_skip_at_time: No groove skip at this time (±2 s)
map_builtin_readonly: “{name}” is built in and read-only. Copy it as your own map and change the copy.
map_nothing_to_delete: Nothing to delete: the map is unchanged or unknown
profile_name_required: Please enter a name for the turntable
profile_switch_while_recording: The turntable cannot be switched during a recording
no_calibration_run: No calibration run yet: record side 1 and 2 of the test record first
run_missing_reference: The run lacks the reference tone (side 1 of the test record): record side 1 first
profile_active_delete: The active profile cannot be deleted: activate another turntable first
setups_ref_higher: The reference tone in run B is {db:.1f} dB higher: was the input level changed? Values relative to the reference stay comparable, clipping and signal-to-noise ratio do not.
setups_ref_lower: The reference tone in run B is {db:.1f} dB lower: was the input level changed? Values relative to the reference stay comparable, clipping and signal-to-noise ratio do not.
setup_recording_running: A recording is currently running for this run
compare_alignment: Alignment recordings are compared via their runs (/api/setups/compare)
compare_not_analyzed: Both recordings must be analyzed first
compare_different_records: Recordings #{a} and #{b} belong to different records. Before/after only compares recordings of the same record side.
compare_different_sides: Recording #{a} is side {side_a}, #{b} is side {side_b}: two sides cannot be overlaid. Before/after only compares recordings of the same record side.
compare_audio_missing: Recording #{id}: a comparison needs the original audio. {reason}
discogs_app_missing: No Discogs app set up (discogs_consumer_key/secret in the configuration)
discogs_token_missing: Enter the personal access token from the Discogs developer settings
discogs_token_invalid: This does not look like a personal access token: copy it again from the Discogs developer settings, without spaces
discogs_username_invalid: Enter the Discogs user name without spaces
oauth_denied: Access was not granted or has expired. Close this window and choose “Connect to Discogs” in the settings again.
oauth_failed: Discogs did not confirm the access: {error}
